heroTitle: Production, Manufacturing & Bill of Materials (BOM) System
heroSubtitle: A comprehensive industrial solution for production lines; Bill of Materials (BOM), work orders, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), quality control, and industrial cost accounting.
heroBoxDesc: Accurate calculation of raw material requirements, workstation routing, and overhead costs.
visionTitle: Maximizing Production Line Efficiency & Eliminating Industrial Waste
visionDesc: Factories require precise synchronization between inventory, sales orders, and daily work plans. USoft delivers an integrated bridge connecting raw materials through routing stages to finished goods.

features.title: Bill of Materials & Product Tree (BOM)
features.desc: Build multi-level product trees with exact standard quantities of raw materials, sub-assemblies, and scrap allowances per finished unit.

features.title: Work Orders & Routing Stage Tracking
features.desc: Issue and route job orders to workstations and production lines, tracking real-time order status (open, in-progress, completed, paused) and throughput.

features.title: Material Requirements Planning (MRP)
features.desc: Analyze sales orders and production forecasts to generate automatic purchase requisitions, preventing assembly bottlenecks and excess stock.

features.title: Direct & Indirect Industrial Costing
features.desc: Accurately allocate raw material costs, machine depreciation, labor rates, and manufacturing overheads directly to the unit production cost.

features.title: Quality Control & Sample Inspection (QC)
features.desc: Quality inspection checkpoints for raw materials upon receipt, work-in-progress (WIP) during stages, and final goods prior to warehouse stocking.

features.title: Machinery Maintenance & Line Scheduling
features.desc: Manage preventive and corrective machine maintenance, track equipment downtime and OEE, and record spare parts consumption.

workflowTitle: Stages of the Production & Manufacturing Cycle

steps.title: BOM Configuration
steps.desc: Define finished good components, routing steps, workstation centers, and standard costs.

steps.title: MRP & Work Order Issuance
steps.desc: Schedule production runs, reserve required materials, and dispatch shift work orders.

steps.title: Material Issue, Routing & QC
steps.desc: Issue stock to shop floor, monitor stage progression, and perform QC sample checks.

steps.title: Finished Goods & Actual Costing
steps.desc: Receive finished inventory into warehouses and finalize actual batch cost breakdown.

closingTitle: Ready to elevate your factory's production line efficiency?
closingDesc: Connect with USoft industrial ERP experts and explore a live demo of the manufacturing system.
